node.statement: Conclusion from the two explicit telescope bounds. By the exact equality in node 1.3.2, the triangle inequality, the first-term estimate in node 1.3.1, and the second-term estimate in node 1.3.2, ||Upsilon_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)-XY||=||Upsilon_n(Z)-XY||<=[C_Upsilon+2*(C_2+C_theta+C_Delta)]*eta*||X||*||Y||. Since n>=1 and X,Y were arbitrary under the root hypotheses, this is precisely the conclusion asserted by node 1.3.
